data.name: Khayyar
data.long_meaning: One who chooses or prefers for himself, from the Arabic root 'kh-y-r'. In the Quran, it refers to Allah, the Chooser of the righteous.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies making righteous choices in life.
data.numerology_meaning: Those with the name Khayyar are adaptable, intellectual, and creative individuals who thrive on change and new experiences.

in_arabic.name: خيار
in_arabic.meaning: خيار تعني الشخص الذي يختار الخير والصلاح
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم خيار مشتق من الفعل اختار، وهو يعني الشخص الذي يختار الخير والصلاح، ويتميز بالحكمة وال discernment في اتخاذ القرارات. ورد ذكر الفعل اختار في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: {وَيَختَارُ مَن يَشَاءُ}، مما يدل على أهمية الاختيار والتمييز بين الخير والشر.

in_urdu.name: خیار
in_urdu.meaning: خیار کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو اچھائی اور بھلائی کا انتخاب کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: خیار نام کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو اچھائی اور بھلائی کا انتخاب کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کے فعل 'اختار' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے 'انتخاب کرنا'۔ اس نام کا ذکر اسلامی تقویم میں بھی ہوا ہے، جہاں یہ اچھے انتخاب کرنے کی خصوصیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: ख़य्यार
in_hindi.meaning: ख़य्यार का अर्थ है वह व्यक्ति जो अच्छाई और भलाई का चयन करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: ख़य्यार नाम का अर्थ है वह व्यक्ति जो अच्छाई और भलाई का चयन करता है। यह नाम अरबी भाषा के क्रिया 'اختار' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है 'चुनना'। इस नाम का महत्व इस्लामी परंपरा में भी है, जहां यह अच्छे विकल्प चुनने की विशेषता को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: خيار
in_pashto.meaning: خيار د معنی داړه چاته کسان د ښه او سمه لار انتخاب کوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: خيار نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کېږي چې د ښه او سمه لار انتخاب کوي. دا نوم د عربي ژبې د 'اختار' کلمې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې 'انتخاب کول' دي. دا نوم د افغان او پښتنو په کلتور کې د پام وړ دی، چیرته چې د ښې لارې انتخاب مهم ګڼل کېږي.

in_english.name: Khayyar
in_english.meaning: Khayyar means the one who chooses goodness and righteousness
in_english.long_meaning: Khayyar is derived from the Arabic verb 'ikhtara', meaning 'to choose'. It signifies someone who selects goodness, righteousness, and wisdom. This name is referenced in the Quran, emphasizing the importance of discernment and choosing the right path. Historically, Khayyar has been used in Islamic tradition to denote individuals with wise decision-making abilities and a strong moral compass.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Khayyar" resonates with the sense of autonomy and self-determination, as it originates from the Arabic "kh-y-r," meaning "to choose." In various Arab and Muslim communities, it is often used for individuals who are seen as having a keen sense of discernment, confidence, and freedom in decision-making. This can manifest in various ways, such as choosing a career, partner, or path in life, all while remaining responsive to guidance from wiser or more experienced individuals.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of "Khayyar" is most profound when one considers Allah, the Chooser, as being the ultimate source of our choices. In the Quran, Allah states, "No disaster occurs upon the earth or in yourselves but is recorded in a Book before We make it happen" (Sura Al-Hadid, 57:22). Muslims understand this as an acknowledgment that Allah guides us all, even when we believe our choices are our own. Furthermore, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) reminds us in a Hadith, "The sky has been measured according to its term, and the Earth has been measured according to its term, and their term is with Allah the All-Knower of the Unseen and the Visible" (Sahih Muslim 6143, Book 40, Hadith 6646). As Muslims, we strive to seek Allah's guidance in our choices, not only understanding that He has prepared our destinies but also seeking His blessings and forgiveness in our actions. Therefore, the name "Khayyar" serves as a reminder that our choices are deeply intertwined with Allah, our ultimate Creator and Chooser, encouraging us to seek His will in our lives.
